sources.evidence: Table of 47 ranked teams with columns Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Citation, headed 'The 2014 Syrian Collegiate Programming Contest', rendered from the icpc.global API archive (contest 2632).

Codeforces gym dashboard of 'Statements (en)' lists problems A-J (Poetry Challenge to Bye Bye Russia), matching the catalogue's problem list; the copy shows names and limits, not the statements themselves.

contest_facts.value: a gym announcement is dated 2014-10-09; the real contest date is not shown

notes: Source 1 is the Codeforces gym mirror: its top team solved 10 problems against 7 for the official winner, and its names differ from the official ones, so it seems to mix later or foreign (virtual/unofficial) participants with the official teams, and the official ones are not distinguishable in the digest. The gym announcement dated 2014-10-09 sits after the catalogue date of 2014-09-23; a human may want to check which date is right.
